import pixeltable as pxt

# Get the existing videos table
videos_table = pxt.get_table('videos')

# Create a view that extracts frames at 1 fps
# Each video row expands into multiple rows (one row per frame)
frames_view = videos_table.create_view(
    'frames_1fps',
    iterator=videos_table.video.extract_frames(fps=1)
)

# Verify the view was created
print(f"Created frame-level view: frames_1fps")
print(f"View schema: {frames_view.schema}")
print(f"Total frame rows: {len(frames_view)}")
